About

A community that learns by building.

FBC is a student-run entrepreneurship community at BITS Pilani. We don't expect every member to become a founder. We want every member to understand how startups work, meet the right people, and try building something.

Mission

Make entrepreneurship open to every BITSian.

Accessible

Any branch, any year, with or without an idea. No selection process to get in.

Practical

Real problems, real startups, real feedback. Less theory, more doing.

Collaborative

Building a startup shouldn't be a lonely ambition. Find the people to do it with.

Roadmap

Where we've been, where we're going.

Phase 0 · Sep 2026

The spark

  • Community invitation and join form
  • WhatsApp community launched
  • First meetup with 3 core members
Phase 1 · Oct–Nov 2026

Matchmaking v1

  • Co-founder matchmaking form
  • Founder profiles shared with the community
Phase 2 · Dec 2026 · In progress

Pitch & platform

  • Pitch Night for matchmaking founders
  • This website: profiles, matchmaking, opportunities
  • Recruit more core members
Phase 3 · Jan–Mar 2027

Learn & publish

  • Workshop series: validation, finance, fundraising
  • Startup Stories newsletter, every two weeks
  • Founder fireside sessions
Phase 4 · Apr–Jun 2027

Build & grow

  • Startup-building challenge
  • Internal demo day with external evaluators
  • Startup opportunity partnerships
Phase 5 · 2027–28

Beyond campus

  • Flagship annual entrepreneurship event
  • Collaboration across BITS campuses
  • Incubator and investor network
